name: The Public Servant
summary: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, Senator Mehr Stonehallow faces a trogg invasion that has halted mining in Dun Morogh. He calls for help against the Rockjaw Bonesnappers so miners can return to work.

sections.title: A Senator in the Field
sections.body: Senator Mehr Stonehallow has come to Gol'Bolar Quarry to direct the response to its trogg infestation. He serves in Ironforge's Senate and belongs to the Explorers' League, yet he has taken charge in person rather than wait for the city's laws to move. He hires travelers and mercenaries to drive the invaders from the mine.

sections.title: The Disaster at Gol'Bolar
sections.body: Deep digging at Gol'Bolar Quarry broke into sealed hollows below the ground. Rockjaw troggs poured into the pits, smashed mining equipment, and drove out the workers. Stonehallow seeks to clear out the Rockjaw Bonesnappers, so Mountaineers can secure the quarry and mining can resume.

faq.answer: Mehr Stonehallow serves in Ironforge's Senate and belongs to the Explorers' League. He has come to Gol'Bolar Quarry to direct the response to the trogg threat.

faq.q: Why is Gol'Bolar Quarry overrun with troggs?
aliases: why are troggs at gol bolar
faq.answer: Miners dug too deeply beneath Gol'Bolar Quarry and broke into caverns inhabited by the Rockjaw troggs. The creatures surged into the pits, smashed equipment, and drove the workers away.
Rockjaw Bonesnappers are fierce fighters among the Rockjaw troggs. They use crude weapons and brute force against dwarven miners and defenders.

faq.q: What is the plan after clearing out the troggs?
faq.answer: After the troggs are driven out, Senator Stonehallow plans to bring in Ironforge Mountaineers to secure the quarry, rebuild its damaged equipment, and resume mining.

faq.q: Why is the Explorers' League involved here?
faq.answer: Senator Stonehallow belongs to the Explorers' League, whose members investigate ancient excavations, underground ruins, and trogg incursions across the Khaz Modan mountains.
Gol'Bolar Quarry lies in southeastern Dun Morogh, in the snowy hills south of the road between Kharanos and the South Gate toward Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see Gol'Bolar's trogg breach threaten your homeland's industry. Deep digging can bring danger from beneath the earth.
As a miner, you know the cost of Gol'Bolar's closure. Troggs now hold the quarry's stone and ore veins.
As an Alliance member, you depend on Ironforge's resources. Keeping Dun Morogh's quarries safe matters to the Alliance's supply.
